passages.text: ​ (amounts in millions, except share and per share data, unless otherwise noted) ​ The following discussion and analysis of the financial condition and results of operations for the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023 has been derived from and should be read in conjunction with the Consolidated Financial Statements and the accompanying Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements included in Part II, Item 8, herein for Amphenol Corporation (together with its subsidiaries, “Amphenol,” the “Company,” “we,” “our,” or “us”). The Consolidated Financial Statements have been prepared in U.S. dollars, in accordance with accounting principles generally accepted in the United States of America (“U.S. GAAP” or “GAAP”). The following discussion and analysis also includes references to certain non-GAAP financial measures, which are defined in the “Non-GAAP Financial Measures” section below, including “Constant Currency Net Sales Growth” and “Organic Net Sales Growth”. For purposes of the following discussion, the terms “constant currencies” and “organically” have the same meaning, respectively, as these aforementioned non-GAAP financial measures. Refer to “Non-GAAP Financial Measures” within this Item 7 for more information, including our reasons for including non-GAAP financial measures and material limitations with respect to the usefulness of the measures. ​ In addition to historical information, the following discussion and analysis also contains certain forward-looking statements that are subject to risks and uncertainties, including but not limited to the risk factors described in Part I, Item 1A. Risk Factors herein, as well as the risks and uncertainties that exist with the use of forward-looking statements as described in the “Cautionary Note Regarding Forward-Looking Statements” section included herein at the beginning of this Annual Report on Form 10-K (“Annual Report”). ​ Overview ​ General ​ Amphenol is one of the world’s largest designers, manufacturers and marketers of electrical, electronic and fiber optic connectors and interconnect systems, antennas, sensors and sensor-based products and coaxial, high-speed, fiber optic and specialty cable. In 2025, approximately 65% of the Company’s sales were outside the United States. The primary end markets for our products are: ​ ● information technology and communication devices and systems for the converging technologies of voice, video and data communications; ​ ● a broad range of industrial applications and traditional, hybrid and electric automotive applications; and ​ ● defense and commercial aerospace applications. ​ The Company’s products are used in a wide variety of applications by a broad array of customers around the world. The Company competes primarily on the basis of technology innovation, product quality and performance, price, customer service and delivery time. For many years, customers have generally been consolidating their lists of qualified suppliers to companies that have the ability to meet certain technical, quality, delivery and other standards while maintaining geographic flexibility and competitive prices. Non-GAAP financial measures related to operating income, operating margin, net income attributable to Amphenol Corporation, effective tax rate and diluted EPS exclude income and expenses that are not directly related to the Company’s operating performance during the years presented. credit_strengths.text: Amphenol's operating margin sits well above the information technology sector median, reflecting pricing power and mix in interconnect systems, sensors and specialty cable. This profitability, combined with revenue growth materially faster than the sector median, supports internally generated funds and cushions cyclical end-market demand across IT, industrial, automotive and aerospace.

Liquidity is a core strength: cash and current assets comfortably cover current liabilities, and the current ratio exceeds the sector median. Net leverage, after netting cash and short-term investments, sits modestly below the sector median, while gross leverage is far below it, giving substantial headroom before any indicative risk-profile deterioration.

key_risks.text: The debt note shows meaningful near-term maturities, including senior notes due within the next twelve months and a larger tranche in the following year, alongside a revolving credit facility and commercial paper programs maturing later. Refinancing these obligations at higher rates would lift interest expense, though current coverage and cash balances provide ample capacity to repay or refinance.

Amphenol's disclosed risk factors include exposure to foreign currency, customer concentration and acquisition integration, with a substantial share of sales outside the United States. The company also reports non-GAAP measures excluding acquisition-related and refinancing costs, so reported profitability may overstate sustainable earnings if such charges recur, warranting scrutiny of cash conversion.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage is strong and above the sector median, with operating income covering gross interest expense many times over. Free cash flow relative to debt is solid, though below the sector median, and operating cash flow covers debt comfortably. This supports timely debt service even if rates rise or demand softens.

Free cash flow comfortably funds dividends and buybacks, but acquisitions absorb the largest share of cash uses, leaving less for debt reduction. Capital expenditure is modest relative to operating cash flow. Continued acquisition spending could keep leverage elevated, though the indicative financial risk profile remains minimal with substantial threshold headroom.

overall_credit_view.text: Amphenol presents a strong credit profile: minimal indicative financial risk, leverage below the sector median, robust coverage and ample liquidity. Revenue and operating income have grown rapidly, and the Altman Z double prime zone is safe. These factors support a stable, investment-grade-like credit view, though the profile is indicative and not a rating.

Forward-looking judgement: debt-funded acquisitions and shareholder returns will likely keep leverage above historical lows, but cash generation and headroom suggest the minimal risk profile is sustainable. Refinancing near-term maturities is manageable given cash and coverage. We would monitor acquisition integration, foreign currency exposure and any shift toward more aggressive distributions.

credit_strengths.text: Amphenol 的營業利潤率遠高於資訊科技行業中位數，反映其在互連系統、傳感器及特種電纜方面的定價能力與產品組合。此盈利能力，加上收入增長明顯快於行業中位數，支持內部產生的資金，並緩衝 IT、工業、汽車及航空航天等週期性終端市場需求。
流動性是一項核心優勢：現金及流動資產穩健覆蓋流動負債，流動比率高於行業中位數。淨槓桿（扣除現金及短期投資後）略低於行業中位數，而總槓桿則遠低於行業中位數，在指示性風險狀況惡化之前提供充裕空間。

key_risks.text: 債務票據顯示有顯著的近期到期債務，包括未來十二個月內到期的優先票據及下一年度較大規模的一批，另有循環信貸融資及較後到期的商業票據計劃。以較高利率為這些債務再融資將增加利息支出，儘管當前覆蓋率及現金結餘提供充足能力償還或再融資。
Amphenol 披露的風險因素包括外匯風險、客戶集中度及收購整合，且相當大比例的銷售來自美國以外。公司亦報告排除收購相關及再融資成本的非 GAAP 指標，因此若該等費用重複出現，報告盈利能力可能高估可持續盈利，需審視現金轉換情況。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 利息覆蓋率強勁且高於行業中位數，營業收入覆蓋總利息支出多倍。自由現金流相對債務穩健，儘管低於行業中位數，而經營現金流穩健覆蓋債務。這支持即使利率上升或需求放緩時仍能按時償債。
自由現金流穩健地為股息及回購提供資金，但收購佔現金用途的最大份額，留給債務削減的資金較少。資本開支相對經營現金流適度。持續的收購支出可能使槓桿保持高位，儘管指示性財務風險狀況仍為極低，且具有充裕的門檻空間。

overall_credit_view.text: Amphenol 呈現強勁的信用狀況：指示性財務風險極低、槓桿低於行業中位數、覆蓋率穩健及流動性充裕。收入及營業收入快速增長，且 Altman Z 雙素區域為安全。這些因素支持穩定、類投資級的信用觀點，儘管該狀況為指示性而非評級。
前瞻性判斷：債務融資的收購及股東回報可能使槓桿保持高於歷史低位，但現金產生及空間表明極低風險狀況可持續。鑑於現金及覆蓋率，近期到期債務的再融資屬可管理。我們將監控收購整合、外匯風險及任何轉向更進取分派的跡象。
